contributions.claim: A 15-year-old lost a hand when a projectile he picked up exploded during Lens school protests; his life is reportedly not in danger.
contributions.uncertainty: French media identify a police flash grenade; origin is attributed.

contributions.claim: Education minister reports 589 schools protested that day and 190 pupils/staff injured since protests began the prior week.
contributions.uncertainty: Aggregate over multiple incidents, not Lens casualties.

contributions.claim: A Paris secondary school was attacked and subsequently evacuated after pupils had been kept inside because of the threat.
Two youths were arrested over separate prior-week incidents: a stone injuring a passerby's eye in Aix-en-Provence and alleged petrol poured on a teacher in La Ciotat.
contributions.uncertainty: Two separate offences grouped only as arrest reporting.

contributions.claim: Belgian school unrest included 30 arrests in Liège, 25 minors detained in Charleroi and 15 arrests in Arlon.
contributions.uncertainty: Related topic, no established shared organising story with France.

relations.reason: Shared school unrest topic alone does not establish a single ongoing matter.

delta_expectations.reason: Central injury event and aggregate protest-wave update.
Separate secondary occurrences carried in the same report.

ambiguity_notes: Guardian aggregate overlaps minister's total; do not treat each source as separate injury event. Future mobilisation call is context, not proof protests occurred.
